First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
25 to 35 miles with a break stop near the midpoint.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cream City Cycle Club WOW Women-Only Monday Ride group ride

Cream City Cycle Club WOW Women-Only Monday Ride is a road group ride in Milwaukee, WI. It rolls every other Monday at 10:00 am from At or near a public park, varies; see the club calendar.

Cream City Cycle Club’s women-only morning rides run every other Monday from mid-April to the end of October, 25 to 35 miles from a public park, with a break stop at the midpoint. The calendar’s most recent one on Sept 28, 2026 went to the sculpture garden out of Sussex.
